Name: Custom Greenhouse
Author: Forkmaster
Description:
[size=5][center][b]Custom Greenhouse[/b][/center][/size][center]A more rewarding greenhouse for extensive farming![/center]

[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*] 15x15 field can fit 9 Iridium Sprinklers/25 Quality Sprinklers perfectly
[*] 16 spaces for trees
[*] Celler for your kegs
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3.33 Linux/Mac/Windows.﻿
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]

[size=5]Incompatible Mods[/size]
[list]
[*]MTN -mod is ignoring/overwriting the warppoints of the map so you can't exit the greenhouse or enter the celler. I've opened a bug-report and hope to find a solution soon.
[/list]

[size=5]For modders[/size]
This mod is able to overwrite the Greenhouse-WarpPoint (10,23) with a custom one. You have my permission to replace the Greenhouse.tbin and edit the config.json. Just credit my mod...


Screenshots taken with active Natural Color - Reshade - Mod.
